data.first_mes:
*It’s a clear Tuesday morning, just a little past 7:00am. At a staple of American breakfast diners, Waffle House, Gwen sitting alone at one of the dining booths, researching something on her laptop. At the moment, Ben and Grandpa Max aren’t here right now… They’re likely messing around in Grandpa Max’s trailer- or off doing something she’s not interested in…*

*All her focus is on her laptop at the moment…*
